TALLY_STOPPED.diagnosticHint: TallyPrime service is not reachable. Verify Tally is open and the HTTP server is enabled under F1: Help > Settings > Connectivity.
TALLY_STOPPED.userAction: Start TallyPrime and ensure server mode is enabled.

WRONG_PORT.diagnosticHint: Target port refused connection. Configured TALLY_PORT does not match TallyPrime's listening port.
WRONG_PORT.userAction: Check Tally connectivity port in TallyPrime settings and update TALLY_PORT in .env.

CONNECTION_REFUSED.diagnosticHint: TCP connection refused on configured host and port.
CONNECTION_REFUSED.userAction: Verify TallyPrime is running and configured port is active.

CONNECTION_TIMEOUT.diagnosticHint: Request to TallyPrime timed out. Tally may be busy or frozen by a modal dialog.
CONNECTION_TIMEOUT.userAction: Check if Tally has open dialog prompts (e.g. Educational Mode) and close them.

NO_COMPANY.diagnosticHint: Tally is responding but no active company is loaded in the workspace.
NO_COMPANY.userAction: Open the target company in TallyPrime.

MALFORMED_XML.diagnosticHint: Response received from Tally could not be parsed as valid XML.
MALFORMED_XML.userAction: Inspect raw response payload for syntax anomalies or encoding issues.

LINE_ERROR.diagnosticHint: Tally processed the request but returned a <LINEERROR> indicating a TDL or query failure.
LINE_ERROR.userAction: Check TDL request compatibility with the running TallyPrime release.

INVALID_ENVELOPE.diagnosticHint: XML response is missing the required root <ENVELOPE> or <HEADER> structure.
INVALID_ENVELOPE.userAction: Verify Tally server response format settings.

EMPTY_RESPONSE.diagnosticHint: Tally returned an empty body (0 bytes).

UNEXPECTED_RESPONSE.diagnosticHint: Tally returned an unexpected HTTP status code or payload format.
UNEXPECTED_RESPONSE.userAction: Review bridge logs and Tally connection settings.

READ_ONLY_VIOLATION.diagnosticHint: Outbound request was rejected by ReadOnlyPolicy because it contains write/import/mutation commands.
READ_ONLY_VIOLATION.userAction: Ensure only read-only export queries are generated by the bridge.

UNKNOWN_ERROR.diagnosticHint: An unclassified error occurred during communication with Tally.
UNKNOWN_ERROR.userAction: Check logs for detailed stack trace and diagnose connectivity.
